# configure gpg and keybase

Set up commit signing from the dotfiles: manage the GPG key through Keybase (the [linked walkthrough](https://blog.scottlowe.org/2017/09/06/using-keybase-gpg-macos/) exports the Keybase PGP key into local GnuPG and points git at it; the [Vault page](https://www.vaultproject.io/docs/concepts/pgp-gpg-keybase) covers Keybase-backed PGP more generally), and have `git_config` turn on signing when the key is present rather than leaving it as a comment block in the installer.
